product: SONGMICS office / gaming chair with footrest OBG77 / 077
summary: Racing-style swivel office chair with five-star base, gas lift, tilt mechanism, pull-out footrest, flip-up armrests, headrest pillow and lumbar pillow.
unclear: Part K is not clearly used in any step; assumed to be the footrest cushion fixed in step 4.

B.name: Seat with footrest rails
B.look: Thick padded seat; underneath are two metal slide rails for the footrest

C.name: Armrests (R and L)
C.look: Curved padded armrests marked R and L, each with two bolt holes at the lower end

D.name: Five-star base
D.look: Large five-arm star base with a centre socket and a hole at the end of each arm

E.name: Castor
E.look: Twin-wheel castor with a metal pin on top

F.name: Gas cylinder
F.look: Long round cylinder with a thin pin and button on top

G.name: Tilt mechanism
G.look: Metal plate with a round socket underneath, two levers with handles, and an upright plate at the back with holes

H.name: Cylinder cover
H.look: Telescopic plastic sleeve in two sections

I.look: Small pillow, narrow in the middle

J.name: Lumbar pillow
J.look: Rectangular back cushion, larger than the headrest pillow

S.name: Backrest bracket

steps.title: Fit the castors
steps.text: Push one castor (E) into the hole at the end of each of the 5 arms of the star base (D). Press each one straight down until it sits fully in.
steps.tip: Push the pin in straight, not at an angle, or it will not seat properly.

steps.title: Insert the gas cylinder
steps.text: Stand the base on its castors and put the gas cylinder (F) into the centre socket, thin pin end up.

steps.title: Slide on the cylinder cover
steps.text: Slide the telescopic cover (H) down over the gas cylinder, narrow end up.
steps.tip: Put the cover on before the seat, it cannot be added later.

steps.title: Fix the footrest under the seat
steps.text: Lay the seat (B) upside down on a soft surface. Fix the footrest frame to the underside through the slotted plates with 4 bolts S100 and the Allen key.

steps.title: Attach the tilt mechanism
steps.text: With the seat still upside down, place the mechanism (G) on the underside so the levers point to the chair's right side and the upright plate is at the back. Fix it with 4 bolts S100, each with a washer S201.
steps.tip: Check the direction: the round socket goes over the cylinder and the upright plate must be at the rear edge of the seat.

steps.title: Put the seat on the base
steps.text: Turn the seat over and lower it so the socket under the mechanism slides onto the top of the gas cylinder.
steps.warn: The seat is bulky; hold it level with both hands.

steps.title: Fix the bracket to the backrest
steps.text: Lay the backrest (A) on its front. Fold back the fabric flap at the bottom and fix the backrest bracket (S) with 4 countersunk bolts S102.
steps.tip: The end with 3 holes must point away from the backrest, down toward the seat.

steps.title: Close the flap
steps.text: Fold the fabric flap back down over the bracket.

steps.title: Mount the backrest
steps.text: Lower the backrest so its bracket sits against the upright plate at the back of the mechanism. Insert 3 bolts S103, each with a washer S202, from behind.
steps.tip: Do not tighten these bolts fully yet, so the armrest holes can still line up.
steps.warn: Hold the backrest until the bolts are in, or ask a helper.

steps.title: Attach the armrests
steps.text: Fit the armrest marked R on the chair's right side and L on the left. Fix each one with 2 bolts S106: one into the side of the seat and one into the side of the backrest.
steps.tip: Start all bolts by hand first, then tighten gradually; don't swap R and L.

steps.title: Tighten all bolts
steps.text: Now tighten all bolts firmly, including the 3 backrest bracket bolts.
steps.tip: Bolt heads must sit flat against the part.

steps.title: Press in the cover caps
steps.text: Press a cover cap S305 into each of the 4 armrest bolt holes until it sits flush.

steps.title: Cover the backrest bracket
steps.text: At the back of the chair, pull the fabric cover down over the backrest bracket as shown by the arrows.

steps.title: Add the pillows
steps.text: Place the headrest pillow (I) at the top of the backrest and the lumbar pillow (J) at the lower back. The chair is finished.

steps.title: Using the controls
steps.text: Pull up the height lever to raise or lower the seat. Lift the tilt lever to unlock and recline the backrest, push it down to lock. Pull the footrest out from under the seat and flip it up.
steps.tip: Do not sit only on the front edge; hold the armrests when standing up.
steps.warn: Max load 150 kg, armrests 68 kg. Never stand on the chair.
